name: Contact Chat Widget
author: Bheema Dharmatheja

sections.description:
The Contact Chat Widget plugin adds a highly customizable and easy-to-use chat button to your WordPress site, allowing your customers to connect with you directly via WhatsApp. With features such as adjustable placement, icon customization, and responsive design, it seamlessly integrates with your website.

Key Features:
– Add a WhatsApp chat button to your site.
– Customize button placement (left or right) and margin.
– Use your custom icons for the chat button.
– Easy integration with responsive design support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Chat Button settings page to configure the button.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the button?

Go to the plugin settings page to customize the button’s position, margin, icon, and phone number.

How do I change the chat button icon?

In the settings page, you can input a URL to the icon you want to use.
